description: Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B with immutable checkpoint files and an ARM64 runtime. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Per-node peak is an estimate: GPU memory utilization times 130,663,231,488 bytes plus 8 GB for runtime/host overhead; reserve is informational, with the platform OS floor accounted separately. Requires exactly 8 Sparks; not runnable on the current two-Spark fleet. Uses the dedicated Muse launch image and an accessible Unsloth NVFP4 distribution. SM121 uses Marlin rather than SM100-only fused MoE; this eight-node adaptation is unqualified. Speculative decoding is omitted until this baseline is qualified.
title: Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B vLLM 8 Sparks
